notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers creating and hardening S3 buckets (public access block, versioning, SSE-KMS, logging), bucket policies, lifecycle rules, cross-region replication, presigned URLs, common CLI operations and equivalent Terraform.

Medium: the agent would run state-changing `aws s3api`/`aws s3` commands with the user's AWS credentials, including two destructive examples in 'Common S3 Operations' — `aws s3 sync ... --delete` (SKILL.md:276-280) and `aws s3 rm s3://my-app-data-prod/temp/ --recursive` (SKILL.md:290). Still acceptable because they are presented as a command reference for operations the user asks for, scoped to a prefix, with placeholder bucket names, and the skill's defaults otherwise harden security (block public access, enforce HTTPS, encryption, versioning). The skill does not add an explicit 'confirm before deleting' step, so the agent should confirm destructive S3 commands with the user.

Review before applying: the sample bucket policy denies all access not coming through vpce-abc123 (SKILL.md:117-131), which locks out console/CLI access from elsewhere if applied unchanged; lifecycle rules expire logs/ after 90 days and noncurrent versions after 180 days. Related Skills (SKILL.md:414-418) link to sibling skills ../aws-iam/, ../aws-vpc/, ../aws-cost-optimization/, ../terraform-aws/, ../cloudformation/ as optional reading only.
